heading: Assistance of district attorney in enforcement of federal act concerning reemployment of veterans.
text: NRS 418.030 Assistance of district attorney in enforcement of federal act concerning reemployment of veterans. A person who claims to be entitled to the benefits of the provisions of 38 U.S.C. §§ 2021 to 2026, inclusive, may apply for the assistance of the district attorney for the county in which the claimant’s employer maintains a place of business. The district attorney, if reasonably satisfied that the person applying is entitled to the benefits, shall appear and act as attorney for that person in the amicable adjustment of the claim, or in the: 1. Filing of any motion, petition or other appropriate pleading; and 2. Prosecution thereof to require specific compliance by the employer with the provisions of 38 U.S.C. §§ 2021 to 2026, inclusive. [3:34:1941; 1931 NCL § 6877.02]—(NRS A 1985, 158 )

heading: Programs for training in actual employment: Conditions for approval; regulations.
text: NRS 418.045 Programs for training in actual employment: Conditions for approval; regulations. 1. The Labor Commissioner may approve programs which provide opportunities for training in actual employment for veterans. The programs must: (a) Extend for at least 6 months and not more than 2 years; (b) Involve only occupations which do not offer programs of apprenticeship; (c) Have a standardized form of training; and (d) Comply with all state and federal laws regarding equal opportunities for employment. 2. The Labor Commissioner may adopt such regulations as may be necessary to administer and oversee these programs. (Added to NRS by 1981, 247 )
